alt: A stone, a wooden block, a glass of water, and an inflated blue balloon rest on a table.
Six small blue spheres are scattered across a white background as symbols for tiny pieces of a substance.
A rectangular wooden block rests on a table.
Clear water fills part of a wide transparent bowl.
A tied, translucent balloon is inflated; the air inside is clear.
An arrow connects an ice cube on a saucer to a smaller piece of ice surrounded by a puddle.
Two matching green trays show water in the left tray and ice cubes in the right tray.
Two views of the same sunlit pavement tile show a puddle shrinking over time; an arrow connects the larger puddle to the smaller one.
A cold metal lid sits above a bowl of water. Small liquid droplets cling to the underside of the lid.
A beam of sunlight falls on a dark stone on a garden path.
A wooden block occupies most of the space inside a transparent rectangular box.
Wooden cubes keep their shape on a plate, in a bowl, and inside a glass.
Water forms a tall narrow shape in a glass and a low wide shape in a bowl.
Two capped syringes without needles show a plunger pulled back and a plunger pushed in, leaving less space for trapped air.
Two closed jars show ice pieces on the left and liquid water on the right.
Two matching blue trays show liquid water on the left and ice cubes on the right.
Three views of the same pavement show a large puddle, a smaller puddle, and a tiny wet patch.
An ice-filled glass stands in a warm kitchen. Droplets coat its outside and a wet ring surrounds its base.
A kettle spout opens into a short clear gap. A white mist plume begins farther away from the spout.
Sixteen blue spheres sit in an orderly square arrangement. Short curved strokes suggest vibration.
Blue spheres cluster irregularly near the bottom of a container; small arrows point between nearby spheres.
Eight small blue spheres are spread throughout a transparent box, with arrows pointing in different directions.
A clear food container with a closed lid holds a small ice cube and shallow water.
A flat blue balloon lies beside an inflated blue balloon.
